s: A sunlit village square; four blindfolded men in simple grey and brown hanfu surround a patient grey elephant, each touching a different part: one hugging a leg, one flapping an ear, one gripping the trunk, one patting the flank; each face shows stubborn certainty, mouths open in argument, free hands gesturing at each other; the elephant's mild eye looks toward the viewer. Dust, low wall, warm light.

A shallow green river with smooth stepping stones; a small chestnut foal with a bundle of wheat sacks on its back stands midstream, water up to its knees, one hoof raised cautiously, expression brave but nervous; on the left bank a placid brown ox nods encouragingly, on the right a small squirrel waves its arms in alarm. Willow trees, reeds, soft daylight.

A nest high in a bare tree branch; an old grey-feathered crow sits hunched and thin with closed eyes, while a young glossy black crow perches on the nest rim, carefully holding a small berry in its beak toward the old bird's mouth; their beaks almost touch. Bare branches, soft pale sky, warm afternoon light, tender mood.

A jungle clearing; a big gentle grey elephant lies tangled in thick green vines, one leg lifted awkwardly, eyes wide but calm; a tiny brown mouse stands on its trunk, gnawing through a vine strand with determination, cheeks puffed; broken vine fibres scattered. Ferns, dappled sunlight, warm friendly tone.

A grassy racetrack path with a red finish ribbon; a small green tortoise plods forward with a determined squint, one foot lifted; in the foreground under a large tree a brown hare sprawls asleep on its back, one ear flopped over its eyes, a half-eaten carrot beside it. Flowers, butterflies, warm midday light, cheerful comic mood.

A Russian log cottage interior with carved window frames and a lace curtain; a stout host in a belted linen shirt and a full beard holds a steaming bowl of fish soup out to his guest with both hands, eyes eager; the guest, a thin bearded man in a plain coat, leans back with a strained polite smile, one hand on his full stomach, cheeks slightly green; several empty bowls stacked beside a samovar. Warm lamp light, woven rug, gentle comedy.

A dirt road beside a field; a frightened scholar in a blue robe clutches a large cloth book bag to his chest, eyes wide, backing away; a grey wolf with bared teeth steps out of the bag, lean and hungry; a sturdy farmer in a straw hat stands behind with a rope, one eyebrow raised, holding a sack open invitingly. Comic tension, dusty light.

A pond edge with a floating leaf in ancient Greece; a tiny black ant rides the leaf safely, waving thanks with one leg; on a low olive branch above, a soft grey dove looks down with a kind tilt of its head; in the background a hunter in a coarse wool tunic crouches behind a bush, a simple wooden bow half-raised, unaware of the ant creeping toward his sandalled foot. Green water, reeds, bright morning.

A summer meadow with a trail of ants carrying grain; three ants in a line haul a fat seed, sweating, faces set; on a broad leaf a green grasshopper lounges on its back, a tiny fiddle made of grass in its forelegs, singing with eyes closed. Golden wheat, bright sun, a sense of lazy contentment versus busy effort.

A dusty road at high noon in ancient Greece with a very short shadow under a grey donkey; a traveller in a simple wool tunic crouches in the donkey's small shade, fanning himself with a straw hat, while the donkey's owner in a coarse cloak stands over him pointing at the animal, red-faced; the donkey's ears are back, about to bolt. Bare hills, heat haze, comic argument.

A cool forest glade; a grey donkey with a long earnest face looks up at a small cicada on a branch, one ear tilted forward; the cicada sits with a drop of dew on a leaf beside it, singing, tiny chest puffed; the donkey's water trough behind is empty and dry. Soft green light, ferns, gentle humour.

A farmhouse courtyard; a small brown puppy bounds joyfully into a seated farmer's lap, tail wagging, tongue out; beside them a grey donkey rears up on its hind legs with forehooves outstretched toward the farmer's chest, mouth open in a bray, eyes hopeful and slightly ridiculous; the farmer's expression is startled. Buckets, straw, warm light, comic scene.

A forest glade; a grey donkey draped in an oversized golden lion's skin struts with its head high, the mane slipping sideways; the skin's empty lion head sits askew over the donkey's own face; small animals, a rabbit, a fox and a squirrel, freeze mid-flee, looking back with wide eyes; in the next moment the donkey's mouth is opening to bray. Soft green light, comic tension.

A field path at night in ancient Greece; a thin scholar in a simple wool chiton and a himation draped over one shoulder walks with his head tipped far back, eyes on the stars, a rolled papyrus scroll in one hand, one bare foot already over the edge of an open stone well; his expression is rapt and utterly unaware; a small clay oil lamp lies forgotten on the grass behind him. Dry cypress silhouettes, deep blue night, bright stars, soft moonlight, gentle comic irony.

A forest hunting path; a knight in light leather armour sits on a startled horse, one hand on his bare shiny head, mouth open in surprise; above him a dark wig tumbles through the air, caught by the wind, a few strands trailing; two companions behind him are laughing openly, one doubled over on his horse. Sunbeams, leaves, light-hearted mood.

A dim hollow log; a small brown bat hangs upside down, wings folded like a cloak, one eye open and sly; below, a long-bodied weasel with sharp teeth peers up, head tilted in confusion, one paw raised; the bat's expression is innocent and hopeful. Dappled dim light, moss, roots, quiet comic tension.

A narrow-necked earthen jar sits on low stone steps; a small boy in a simple tunic has his fist stuffed inside, clutching a huge handful of glossy brown chestnuts, face crumpled and tearful, arm straining; beside him a passing traveller with a walking staff kneels and gestures for him to let go, smiling kindly. Warm evening light, market wall, a basket of chestnuts spilled nearby.

A grassy hillside with a flock of white sheep; a shepherd boy in a patched tunic cups his hands to his mouth, shouting with a mischievous grin, eyes dancing; at the bottom of the slope three villagers run up with sticks, faces anxious; no wolf in sight. A grey wolf silhouette is just appearing behind a rock in the middle distance, unnoticed. Bright sky, green hills.

A farmhouse yard; an old farmer with a grey beard holds out a thick bundle of birch sticks tied with cord to three grown sons who strain and grunt trying to snap it; on the ground beside them, a single stick lies broken in two. The father's expression is patient and knowing. Woodpile, stone wall, late afternoon light.

A desert sandstorm; a tall camel with a calm eye stands with its body as a shelter, two long legs planted, sand streaming around its hump; huddled behind it are a small rabbit, a hedgehog and a fox, eyes squinted against the wind; a bright wall of blowing sand sweeps past. Golden-tan palette, dramatic wind, warm protective mood.

A workshop courtyard; a calm man in a blue robe stands perfectly still with his hands behind his back, chin slightly raised, eyes steady, a tiny white smudge on the very tip of his nose; beside him a burly carpenter with rolled sleeves swings a large axe in a clean arc, blurred with motion, expression confident. Wood chips in the air, raking light, tension and trust.

A dark corner under the floorboards; a circle of mice sits in a meeting around a candle stub, a small mouse pointing proudly at a sketch of a cat with a bell on its collar; the oldest mouse strokes his whiskers with a doubtful squint; one mouse hides behind a grain sack. Warm candlelight, wooden beams, comic hesitation.

A barn doorway; a sleek grey cat with a sly narrowed gaze has one paw on a bright-feathered rooster's tail, leaning in with an accusing tilt of its head; the rooster stands tall, chest out, beak open in dignified protest, wings slightly lifted. Straw, a wooden bucket, morning light slanting in, tension but no violence shown.

A barnyard dirt patch; a proud rooster with iridescent green-black tail feathers stands over a large glittering cut gem in the dust, head tilted, one foot raised to nudge it aside; a scattered handful of wheat grains lies a little further on, and the rooster's gaze is fixed on the grain. Straw, a wooden fence, warm morning light, ironic tone.

A dry garden path with a tall narrow-necked clay pitcher; a glossy black crow stands on the rim, wings half spread for balance, beak holding a small pebble, several pebbles already at the bottom of the pitcher; the water level has risen partway up. Parched earth, a low wall, hot midday light, clever determined mood.

A wooden footbridge over a calm stream; a brown dog leans over the rail with a big chunk of meat in its jaws, eyes wide, mouth already opening to bark at the identical dog and meat reflected in the water below; the real meat is slipping from its teeth, droplets beginning to fall. Morning light, green banks, comic timing frozen.

Open sea with gentle waves; a friendly dolphin with a smooth grey back swims with a wet, shivering brown dog clinging to it, the dog's ears plastered down, tail drooping; the dolphin turns its head back with a cheerful open-mouthed smile, one fin raised as if chatting. Blue water, bright sky, a distant shoreline, light comic irony.

A farmyard fence at dusk; a plump glossy dog with a thick collar sits comfortably, one paw raised, showing a worn patch of fur at its neck; opposite, a lean grey wolf with ribs showing stands outside the fence, ears pricked, weighing the offer with a sceptical frown. Wooden gate, warm light from a window, thoughtful mood.

A stable interior; a small brown dog lies curled in a wooden manger full of sweet hay, chin on paws, eyes half closed but watchful; a big brown cow with a patient face leans in, muzzle toward the hay, one eyebrow-like ridge raised in mild reproach. Wooden beams, dust in a shaft of light, comic stubbornness.

A tall old tree beside a burrow; a fierce golden eagle perches on a high branch with a scrap of meat in its talons, wings half spread, glaring down; below at the tree's base a small red fox looks up with wet, furious eyes, one paw pressed to its chest; three fluffy fox cubs hide behind her legs. Late afternoon, dramatic light, tension without gore.

A Russian town street; an enormous grey elephant walks calmly with a small handler on its back, ears flapping; beside it a tiny curly-tailed pug dances and yaps at the giant legs, chest puffed, eyes squeezed shut with effort; other dogs watch from the side, one tilting its head; low wooden houses and a cobbled lane. Warm daylight, comic scale contrast.

A freshly dug field; a sunburned farmer in a straw hat lifts a clay jar overflowing with gold coins from a hole, laughing with his head thrown back, one hand on his hip; behind him, half hidden in warm light, a graceful goddess figure in pale gold robes with a wheat sheaf in her arms smiles with a gently raised eyebrow. Turned earth, bright sky, ironic warmth.

A storm-washed dirt road with a broken stone bridge; a farmer in a coarse wool cloak huddles under a thatched lean-to, arms wrapped around himself, looking anxiously toward home; a shaggy brown dog arrives at a run, soaked, tail wagging hard, turning back as if to lead the way up a slope; rain easing, grey-gold light, loyal warm mood.

A field with an old crumbling stone wall; a farmer in a brown tunic chases a golden eagle that has snatched his straw hat, arms outstretched, expression indignant; behind him, the wall collapses in a burst of dust exactly where he had been standing; the eagle drops the hat and wheels upward. Dynamic dust, sunlight, comic timing with a warm message.

A snowy roadside; an old farmer in a thick coat kneels, cradling a stiff blue-grey snake against his chest inside his coat, face full of pity; the snake's head is lifting slightly, eyes opening with a cold glint, mouth beginning to open; the man's expression still kind and unaware. Bare trees, white snow, cool tones, quiet foreboding.

A dried mud rut in a dusty road; a silver fish lies curved in the cracked mud, gills working, one eye turned up hopefully; crouching beside it a traveller in a blue robe points dramatically toward a distant river, one hand shading his eyes, expression grand and generous; a cracked clay pot lies nearby. Harsh sunlight, dust, dry grass, gentle irony.

A misty lakeside at dusk in ancient Greece; a fisherman in a rough wool tunic with a rope belt kneels by a woven willow basket, holding up a small silver fish in one hand, considering it with a doubtful squint; the fish's mouth is open as if pleading; a simple reed fishing rod leans against a rock, the empty basket beside him. Calm water, fading light, quiet mood.

A kitchen shelf with a clay pot of golden honey, lid askew; four flies stand in the honey, legs sunken, bodies glossy, all still feeding greedily, eyes half closed; a fifth fly hovers above, watching with a worried tilt of its head. Warm kitchen light, a wooden spoon, a towel, bright sticky golden palette with a hint of warning.

A cottage table; a long-beaked white crane stands beside a wide flat plate of soup, neck bent awkwardly, one eye narrow with polite frustration; opposite, an orange fox laps up its own soup from a matching plate with obvious delight, tail curled, one eye peeking up slyly. Wooden bowls, a candle, warm evening light.

A tree branch above a forest path; a black crow holds a piece of meat in its beak, chest puffed, eyes half shut with pleasure at the compliments; below, an orange fox sits back on its haunches, one paw raised in an elegant gesture, mouth open mid-flattery, eyes bright with cunning; the meat is just beginning to slip. Green canopy, warm sunlight.

A forest at dusk; an orange fox crouches low in tall grass, ears flat, body tense, eyes wide with fright; on a branch above, a round red drum hangs from a cord, and the wind has just struck it, with visible motion lines and a puff of dust. Ferns, dark trunks, cool blue-green tones, comic tension.

Inside a stone well; a nimble orange fox stands on the back of a white goat, one forepaw on the well rim, ready to leap out, expression smug; the goat looks up with big trusting eyes, beard dripping, hooves braced on the wet stones. Mossy bricks, a circle of daylight above, faint water below, wry humour.

A vineyard trellis heavy with purple grapes; an orange fox stands on its hind legs, front paws stretched high, tongue out with effort, just short of the lowest bunch; a few leaves fall; the fox's expression is a mix of longing and injured pride, chin lifted as if deciding the grapes must be sour. Golden afternoon light, vine leaves, comic tension.

A riverbank after a soaking; an orange fox lies flat on the grass, fur plastered and dripping, eyes closed in weary patience; a plump hedgehog with raised spines stands beside it, one paw extended toward a cluster of small flies on the fox's back, face earnest and helpful; the fox lifts one eyelid with a resigned look. Wet stones, reeds, soft light.

A sunlit clearing; a sleek spotted leopard poses with its side turned, tail high, chin lifted proudly, showing off its patterned coat; an orange fox sits calmly on a rock opposite, one paw raised, a knowing half-smile on its face, eyes bright and steady. Grass, dappled shade, elegant composition, witty tone.

A dark cave mouth in a rocky hillside; a thin, cautious fox stands well outside, nose lifted, ears forward, one forepaw raised mid-step; deep in the shadows a huge old lion lies with its chin on its paws, eyes glinting, a small sly smile. Around the entrance, many footprints lead inward and none lead out. Cool grey rock, a shaft of sunlight.

A cluttered ancient Greek actor's dressing room; an orange fox sits on a low wooden stool holding up a painted theatrical mask with a tragic open mouth and arched brows, turning it over with both paws; the fox's own expression is sorrowful and wry; a shelf of comic and tragic masks, a folded linen costume, a bronze hand mirror. Warm dusty light through a high window, theatrical mood.

A green pond bank; a tiny green frog puffs its cheeks and belly out as wide as it can, eyes bulging, legs splayed, straining to look big; behind it a huge brown ox grazes calmly, filling much of the background; the frog's mother stands at the water's edge with a worried, waving gesture. Reeds, lily pads, bright day, comic exaggeration.

A mossy stone well; a small green frog sits on the rim, chest puffed, one leg gesturing grandly at the little circle of sky above the well; beside the well a huge soft-shelled sea turtle rests on the grass, one flipper raised toward the horizon, expression patient and amused. Wide open sky beyond, distant sea, gentle wisdom.

A lily pond crowded with worried frogs; a big grey log has just splashed into the water, sending up a ring of ripples, and several frogs peek out from behind lily pads with doubtful, disappointed faces; one frog sits on the log, prodding it with a toe. Green water, reeds, soft overcast light, comic misgiving.

Close-up in a green pasture; a small mosquito perches on the tip of a huge brown bull's curved horn, stretching its legs politely; the bull's eye is visible far to the side, mild and unconcerned, muzzle in the grass; the mosquito's expression is earnest and self-important. Blades of grass, warm sunlight, gentle ironic humour.

A savannah clearing; a tiny mosquito hovers right in front of a huge lion's nose, wings blurred with motion, posture jaunty; the lion's eyes are crossed with irritation, one paw swiping at empty air, mane ruffled; behind the lion a spider web glints between two branches. Golden grass, warm light, comic tension with foreshadowing.

A farmyard; a plump white goose stands beside a nest holding one gleaming golden egg, one wing tucked; the farmer crouches beside it with both hands on the goose, face greedy and impatient, jaw set, eyes fixed on the bird rather than the egg; the goose's eye is wide with alarm. Straw, a wooden fence, morning light, a moment of foolish greed.

A grassy field at golden hour; a lean brown hare sprints flat out with ears back and eyes determined, legs stretched in full stride; behind it a long-legged hunting dog runs hard, tongue out, but with a slightly less desperate face; a hunter with a hunting horn watches from a distant hill. Motion, dust, warm light, energetic composition.

A still forest pool at dusk; a slender deer stands at the water's edge, head lowered, admiring the reflection of its branching antlers, nose almost touching the surface; its thin legs are hidden by reeds; behind the trees a lion's eyes gleam in the shadows, watching. Quiet water, ferns, deep blue-green tones, gentle tension.

A hillside shrine in ancient Greece: a small whitewashed altar with a stone statue of a shepherd god, a few olive branches and a clay cup laid on it; a herdsman in a coarse wool tunic kneels with both hands raised, face earnest in a big promise; behind him, tied to an olive tree, a small calf nuzzles its mother, and a fine large bull grazes peacefully further off. Warm dusk, olive hills, ironic warmth.

A meadow at the forest edge; a proud brown horse stands with a leather bridle and bit being fitted by a man in a simple tunic, the man's hand raised toward the horse's head; the horse's expression is impatient and eager, eyes fixed on a distant stag near the treeline; a saddle lies on the grass. Green meadow, morning light, quiet moral weight.

A nest of tiny larks hidden in a golden wheat field; the mother lark stands on the nest rim with wings half open, calm and knowing, while three fluffy chicks huddle together, eyes wide, beaks open in worry; in the distance a farmer with a scythe inspects the crop. Ripe wheat, warm sun, gentle tension.

A cross-section view: above ground, a lush canopy of green leaves rustling in the wind, glossy and proud; below ground, the same tree's sturdy brown roots spread wide among rocks and soil, one root with a calm, patient face looking up; a cutaway of earth between them. Rich browns and greens, soft light, quietly thoughtful.

A muddy water hole at midday; a big lion and a bristly wild boar stand head to head, both with chests out and teeth bared, a cloud of dust between them; above, three vultures circle in a pale sky, one descending. Dry grass, cracked mud, harsh light, tension that is about to break into truce.

A farmhouse yard; a huge lion sits on its haunches with one front paw extended, a long thorn visible in the pad, its face screwed up in pain but patient; a farmer in a brown tunic kneels close, both hands gently working the thorn loose, tongue between his teeth in concentration; chickens scatter in the background. Warm dusk, straw, gentle courage.

A grassy clearing; a huge lion lies on its side with one paw resting lightly over a tiny brown mouse, not pressing; the mouse is on its hind legs with tiny paws clasped, begging earnestly, eyes huge; the lion's expression is amused and indulgent, one eyebrow lifted. Sun-warmed grass, soft bokeh, tender comic moment.

A hunting clearing with three piles of game; a grey donkey stands proudly beside three neatly equal shares, one hoof gesturing at them, mouth open in a confident explanation; a big lion looms over him with eyes narrowed and mane bristling, one paw raised; an orange fox sits well off to the side, watching with a small wise smile. Warm light, comic tension.

A dusty country crossroads where five paths meet, each splitting again into more; a small group of villagers in simple robes stands at the centre, one scratching his head, another shading his eyes down a path; a single sheep's hoofprint in the dust; nested forks recede into the distance. Dry grass, glaring light, sense of confusion.

A summer tree branch; a green cicada sits singing, translucent wings raised; behind it a green mantis creeps forward, forelegs raised, eyes fixed, entirely focused on the cicada; behind the mantis a yellow oriole perches on a higher twig, head lowered, watching the mantis; below, in the leafy shade, a hunter's net is spread. Layered composition, warm green light.

A narrow mouse hole in a stone wall; a crowd of small brown mice squeezes into the hole in a panic, tails and feet flailing; three large mice wearing little horned helmets are stuck fast at the entrance, helmets wedged against the stone, faces red with effort and terror; a shadow of a cat falls across them. Dust, motion, comic disaster.

A country lane; a young milkmaid in a simple blue dress and white apron carries a full pail of milk balanced on her head, chin up, eyes dreamy, a happy smile on her face as she imagines; her head is tilted just slightly too far, and the milk is beginning to slosh over the rim. Wildflowers, blue sky, bright morning, comic foreshadowing.

A small walled garden at dusk in ancient Greece; a thin old man in a plain wool cloak kneels beside a shallow hole in the earth, both hands pressed to his cheeks, mouth open in a wail, tears on his cheeks; the hole is empty; beside him a neighbour with a wooden hoe leans on it, eyebrows raised, gesturing at the man's patched clothes and empty purse. Loose soil, a stone, soft blue light, wry tone.

A riverbank; a brown monkey is comically tangled in a fishing net, one arm through a mesh, tail wrapped around a rope, net over its head, eyes wide with alarm; behind it a fishing basket and a rod on a rock, water rippling close by. Willows, morning mist, gentle comic chaos.

A barn wall with a small round hole; a tiny brown mouse peeks out, one paw on the edge, nose twitching, grinning with satisfaction; outside, a huge brown bull lowers its head and pushes one horn at the hole, much too big, eyes crossed with frustration, hooves stamping. Straw, wooden beams, warm dusty light, comic scale contrast.

A mountain road with a pack saddle; a sturdy mule stands with a load of bundles, one ear turned back, expression thoughtful rather than sulky; to the left, on a lower path, a sleek horse trots proudly; to the right, a patient donkey plods with a heavy basket. The mule stands between them, chest out, finding its own balance. Warm afternoon, layered landscape.

A country road under a dramatic sky; a traveller in a blue cloak clutches it tightly around himself, leaning into a gust of wind, hat brim bent, leaves and dust whipping past; in the upper left a scowling wind spirit with puffed cheeks and swirling grey hair blows hard; in the upper right a warm smiling sun with soft golden rays begins to glow. Split-sky composition.

A riverbank in a storm; a mighty oak stands rigid, trunk creaking, branches straining, roots beginning to lift from the soil, bark splitting, face-like knots set in stubborn defiance; beside it slender reeds bend almost flat to the ground, calm and unbothered, one reed with a serene expression. Dark storm clouds, rain streaks, dramatic wind.

A woodland path at dusk; a bent old man in a patched grey robe sits on a bundle of firewood, wiping his forehead, eyes closed in exhaustion; before him a tall pale figure in a long dark cloak with a hood stands quietly, one skeletal hand extended; the old man's eyes have just snapped open in alarm, one hand raised. Cool grey-blue palette, quiet mystery.

A tree branch at dusk; a round owl with big amber eyes stands with a small bundle tied to a stick over its shoulder, looking east with a stubborn expression; opposite, a grey dove tilts its head with a patient questioning look, one wing lifted; a forest village in the distance. Purple-orange sky, gentle moral tone.

A dirt road with a heavy loaded cart; two sturdy oxen strain in their yoke, heads down, sweat on their shoulders, muscles taut; behind the cart, the wooden axle creaks loudly, drawn with visible squeal lines and a small indignant face in the wood grain; one ox turns its head back with an annoyed glare. Dust, warm light, comic contrast.

A hillside on fire with orange flames and grey smoke; a small green parrot flies low over the blaze, wings dripping water, a determined set to its beak; below, a wide river glints; other birds flee in the opposite direction; in the clouds above, a tall figure in flowing white robes watches with a moved expression. Dramatic warm palette, heroic smallness.

A sheep pen in a European farmyard; a farmer in a coarse wool tunic and rope belt holds a squirming pink piglet under one arm, his face calm; the piglet's mouth is open in a loud squeal, legs kicking, eyes squeezed shut; around them several woolly sheep stand watching with mild, puzzled expressions, one chewing. Straw, wooden rails, morning light, comic contrast.

A birch grove clearing in old Russia; a monkey with a violin, a donkey with a cello, a goat with a wooden flute and a bear with a drum sit in a neat semicircle on a carved wooden bench, all playing with great earnestness and terrible coordination, cheeks puffed, brows furrowed; a small nightingale perches above on a birch branch, one wing raised like a conductor, expression pained but patient. Pale birch trunks, warm light.

A river crossing; a grey donkey stands in the shallow water with two saddle bags, one bag split and white salt dissolving into the stream, the donkey's expression slyly pleased; on the bank, the driver in a straw hat wades in to grab the halter, face annoyed; wet stones, willows, bright water, comic mischief.

A bedroom interior in ancient Greece; a pale man in a rumpled linen sleeping tunic sits up in bed, one hand on his stomach, gesturing dreamily with the other as if describing a pleasant walk; a doctor in a plain himation sits on a stool beside the bed, taking his pulse with two fingers, eyebrows raised sceptically; on the bedside table an empty bowl and a pile of snack crumbs. Soft lamp light, plaster walls.

A dense grape arbour; a deer crouches low among hanging vines, body hidden behind leaves, ears flat, eyes wide and watchful; a hunter with a bow stands just outside, looking the other way, one hand shading his eyes; a few grape leaves near the deer's mouth have been nibbled, and a torn leaf is drifting down. Dappled light, tense stillness.

A Russian riverbank with a loaded wooden cart; a white swan strains upward at a rope tied to the cart, wings beating; a crayfish grips the same rope and pulls backward toward the water, claws dug in; a pike pulls sideways toward the river, body bending; the cart sits perfectly still, wheels unmoved, and all three are sweating; a peasant in a belted linen shirt watches with his hands on his hips. Comic tension, bright day.

A modest ancient Greek home interior; a small boy in a plain wool tunic holds out a wooden wax writing tablet to his mother with a proud, hopeful grin; the mother in a simple draped dress claps her hands and smiles indulgently; in the background through a doorway, a sunlit courtyard where children practise letters is visible. Warm oil-lamp light, plaster walls, gentle foreshadowing.

A country race path with a red ribbon stretched between two posts; a green tortoise crosses the finish line, one foot raised, sweat on its brow, a small satisfied smile; far behind under a tree, a brown hare has just woken up, ears straight up, mouth open in horror, one hind leg still tangled in grass. Flowers, butterflies, bright day, joyful comic finish.

A town house dining room at night; a long table laden with cheese, cake and fruit; two mice sit frozen on the cloth, ears up, eyes wide, one holding a crumb mid-bite; in the doorway a cat's silhouette with glowing eyes; moonlight through tall windows, silver and warm candlelight mixed, comic suspense.

A broad-leafed plane tree beside a dusty road; three tired travellers sit in its deep shade, hats off, fanning themselves, one gesturing dismissively at the tree with a smirk; the tree's trunk has a kindly, slightly hurt face in its bark, one branch drooping; sunlight beyond the shade, dust motes, warm moral tone.

A forest road in ancient Greece; a man in a plain wool tunic holds up a shiny bronze axe with a gleeful grin, showing it to his companion; the companion in a shorter tunic spreads both hands emphatically, eyebrows raised; behind them along the road, an angry woodcutter in a leather apron runs toward them, one arm raised. Pines, dust, comic tension.

A forest path; a huge brown bear stands sniffing the face of a man lying rigid on the ground, eyes squeezed shut, arms at his sides, trying not to breathe; in the branches above, the second man clings to a trunk, one leg hooked over a limb, peeking down with a guilty expression. Deep green shadows, dappled light, comic fear.

A battlefield edge in soft haze in ancient Europe; a young soldier in a simple bronze breastplate over a wool tunic holds a brass trumpet, head bowed, shoulders slumped, cheeks flushed; opposite him an enemy officer in dark leather armour crosses his arms with a stern, unimpressed expression, one finger raised in accusation; broken spears in the grass behind. Muted colours, dusty light, no blood.

A sandy beach at low tide; a small crab scuttles sideways with a cheerful, carefree expression, claws up; beside it a larger mother crab walks in the same sideways way, then turns her head back with a sudden embarrassed blink, one claw raised to her shell; wet sand, shells, gentle waves, playful mood.

A dry pond bed with cracked mud; two green frogs stand at the edge, one pointing excitedly toward a deep stone well, the other holding up a warning hand, brow furrowed; the well's dark mouth occupies one side, a bucket rope hanging down. Withered reeds, harsh light, quiet sense of danger.

Two pots floating down a gentle river, tied loosely together by a rope; one is shiny copper with a confident, friendly face, one dull clay with a wary, polite expression, turned slightly away; water ripples between them, a rope loop sagging; green banks, soft daylight, gentle wit.

A garden with strutting peacocks; a grey jackdaw stands in the middle, covered in borrowed iridescent peacock feathers stuck at odd angles, chest puffed, chin high; three real peacocks surround it with sharp beaks and narrowed eyes, one already plucking a feather loose; a few grey feathers and fallen peacock plumes on the grass. Bright colours, comic humiliation.

A warm room in a Roman house with a small table and a mousehole; a beautiful young woman in an elegant draped chiton sits gracefully on a cushion, but her posture is suddenly that of a hunter, one hand raised, eyes fixed and fierce, about to pounce; a tiny mouse darts past her feet; through the window, a white marble statue of a serene goddess covers her eyes. Soft interior light, mosaic floor, comic irony.

A forest clearing; a grey wolf sits with its head tipped back, mouth open wide, eyes watering, one paw at its throat; a tall white crane leans in with its long beak deep inside the wolf's mouth, neck curved, one eye nervously on the wolf's teeth. Ferns, soft green light, tense comic moment.

A stream with clear water; a small white lamb stands downstream, drinking, head turned up with wide innocent eyes and a pleading tilt; on the bank upstream a grey wolf leans forward over the water, one paw raised, mouth open mid-accusation, eyes cunning. Pebbles, reeds, soft daylight, quiet tension.

A courtyard; a man in a grey scholar's robe holds a knife and the rope of a plump pig, expression firm and calm; his wife in a blue robe has both hands raised in protest, mouth open, half-laughing with embarrassment; a small child clings to her skirt, peeking out with wide eyes. A stone stove, wooden bucket, warm afternoon light, moral resolve.
